thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page — GPU pool g2-prod is reporting sustained saturation and autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes. Observed queue growth and token throttling. Root cause suspected: recent model rollout increasing memory / KV-cache working set. Investigating.
Natalie: ACKing, I'm on-call. Starting root-cause triage. Can someone confirm which model rollout went to prod around 23:40 UTC?
Mario: that was my deploy — rolled v4.2.1 of the conversational model at 23:38 UTC. Noted a config change: kv_cache.max_entries bumped from 200k -> 800k to improve context reuse.
Olivia: seeing GPU allocation errors in autoscaler logs, looks like scale requests are being rejected by quota checks. Queue length on g2-prod has jumped from 50->120 in 10m. Metrics: p95 latency spiked to 3.2s token.
infra-bot: autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T23:46:02Z ERROR autoscaler: scale_request failed: quota_limit_exceeded: requested 4 gpus, limit 2 for account=redwood-prod-region-a
2026-03-15T23:46:03Z WARN  autoscaler: retrying in 30s
2026-03-15T23:46:35Z ERROR server: request enqueue timeout -> 504 upstream
```
Natalie: are we hitting vendor/GPU soft limits or our own reservation policy? If quota, raising ticket will take time. Need short-term mitigation to stop customer impact.
Mario: confirm it's both — the global account quota for this region is low and our reserved pool is fully used. The v4.2.1 change increased per-request KV memory by ~3-4x because of more aggressive prefill/prefix caching. That increased packing per-GPU and reduced how many concurrent sessions a node can handle.
Amy: support telemetry shows two enterprise customers getting increased 5xx and 10s+ tail latencies: AcadiaHealth and CloudCadet (billing alert triggered). Both on g2-prod region. Customers are asking for ETA.
Jake: urgent customer impact — we need an ETA and mitigation plan. If rollback is possible quickly, prefer that.
Mario: I can rollback the rollout to v4.1.8 (previous stable) — that should reduce KV working set back to baseline. Rolling back now will reject new model traffic and should drain current sessions gracefully.
Mario: running rollback command (will run in canary then global):
```
# redeploy previous model variant
redwood deploy set-version --model conversational --version v4.1.8 --target g2-prod --strategy immediate
```
Natalie: while rollback runs, do we have a traffic-splitting fallback we can enable to reduce pressure? Suggest route 20% traffic to smaller model (v3-small) and disable aggressive prefill on v4.2.1.
Olivia: enabling routing rule to divert 30% to v3-small now via console. Also toggling kv_cache.eviction_policy=aggressive on remaining v4.2.1 instances to free up working set. Commands:
```
# set route
redwood traffic allocate --from model:conversational --to model:conversational:v3-small --percent 30 --region g2-prod
# toggle eviction
redwood config set --model conversational --region g2-prod kv_cache.eviction_policy=aggressive
```
infra-bot: routing rule applied, eviction policy update sent to 12 instances; autoscaler still reporting quota errors for additional nodes.
Natalie: good. Mario — status on rollback?
Mario: rollback initiated, canary completed and health is green for canary. Proceeding global now (expected 90s to propagate).
infra-bot: global rollback finished at 23:52:18 UTC. Observed immediate reduction in KV working set and per-node concurrency increased ~2.8x. Queue length trending down: 120 -> 28 over 6 minutes.
Olivia: monitoring — p95 token latency back to 1.1s, error rate decreasing. We still have throttles from upstream for ~8 pending scale requests (vendor quota). Opening vendor support case now, but immediate customer impact appears mitigated.
Amy: informing AcadiaHealth and CloudCadet via templates. ETA to fully stable: 15-30m based on queue drain.
Jake: capture timeline + customer impact for postmortem. We need to scope: change in kv_cache config + lack of region quota headroom -> P1.
Natalie: creating incident ticket and paging postmortem owners. Action items: (1) verify model release checklist includes estimated per-node kv working set; (2) add pre-deploy autoscaler dry-run to check expected node counts; (3) request quota increase for region A; (4) write a hot rollback runbook for large kv changes.
Mario: noted. I'll add a revert toggle to the rollout pipeline so we can do instant rollbacks without full redeploy.
Olivia: capturing graphs + logs, will attach to incident ticket. Also recommending temporary guardrails: cap kv_cache.max_entries to 300k for major rollouts until we validate memory impact.
incident-bot: Incident update — mitigated (traffic diverted + rollback), monitoring for full recovery. P1 remains open for postmortem and quota remediation. Please add any follow-ups to the ticket: INC-2026-0487. :white_check_mark:
Natalie: thanks team. If anything regresses, re-page. I'll do handover notes for morning SRE shift. Closing in ~2h after verification. :lock:
